_comment: No active vulnerability bypasses. Format and rules: see README.md in this directory.
The two react-router entries that lived here were removed on 2026-08-23 when the
React 19 / react-router 8 migration landed. Worth recording WHY, because their
stated reason had already stopped being true before the migration ran:
They bypassed GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 on the grounds that 'no patched version exists
for React 18'. That was correct when written. It is not correct now — the advisory
was subsequently amended, and its affected ranges are >=7.12.0 <7.18.2 and
>=8.0.0 <8.3.0. react-router 7.18.2, which this repo was already pinned to, is the
7.x patch. So the gate had been passing on its own merits, not on the bypass, and
npm audit reported 0 vulnerabilities with these entries in place.
The repo now runs react-router 8.3.0, which is patched on the 8.x line.
The lesson for the next bypass: a bypass records a judgement about the world at a
point in time, and advisories get re-scoped. Re-read the advisory before renewing
one, rather than trusting the reason written into it.
